# utem Provider

Manage UTEM platform resources — integrations, scan schedules, policies, notification rules, and webhooks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    utem = {
      source  = "Innavoto/utem"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "utem" {
  # Set via environment variables:
  #   UTEM_BASE_URL  (default: https://utem.innavoto.com)
  #   UTEM_API_KEY   (required)
  #   UTEM_TENANT_ID (default: 1)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) UTEM API key. Defaults to UTEM_API_KEY env var.
- `base_url` (String) UTEM API base URL. Defaults to UTEM_BASE_URL env var.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant ID. Defaults to UTEM_TENANT_ID env var.
